Accounts.description: Account settings, profile updates, security credentials, ownership, and privacy inquiries

Billing.description: Bill amounts, invoice viewing, charge explanations, bill disputes, and fee/credit inquiries

Payments.description: Making bill payments, prepaid recharges/top-ups, AutoPay management, payment methods, and payment arrangements

Disconnect.description: Cancelling lines, closing accounts, port-out PINs, temporary suspensions, and termination fee inquiries

Plans.description: Mobile voice/data plans, plan upgrades/downgrades, add-on packs, family plans, and eligibility discounts

Equipment.description: Mobile phones, devices, routers, SIM/eSIM cards, upgrades, trade-ins, unlocking, warranty, and orders

Usage.description: Mobile data consumption, hotspot usage, roaming usage, call/SMS history, data caps, and usage alerts

Technical Support.description: Network connectivity issues, no signal, slow data speeds, dropped calls, SMS/voicemail failures, and technical troubleshooting

intents.intent_name: Incoming Calls Going Straight to Voicemail
intents.description: Callers report that the user's phone never rings and goes straight to voicemail
intents.sample_utterance: Everyone who calls me says it goes straight to voicemail without my phone ever ringing.

intents.description: User ported their number from another carrier and can make calls, but incoming calls/texts fail
intents.sample_utterance: I ported my number over yesterday; I can make outgoing calls, but incoming calls still don't work.

intents.intent_name: VoLTE / HD Voice Call Quality Issue
intents.description: User hears robotic/garbled audio or echo during voice calls
intents.sample_utterance: People say my voice sounds robotic and choppy whenever I'm on a cellular voice call.

intents.description: User is unable to merge calls into a 3-way conference call
intents.sample_utterance: Every time I tap 'Merge Calls' for a 3-way call, it disconnects both callers.

intents.description: User receives normal texts from friends, but bank/app verification short-code SMS never arrive
intents.sample_utterance: I'm not receiving any 6-digit verification codes from my bank or apps via SMS short codes.

intents.description: User's phone hotspot turns on, but laptops connect with 'No Internet Access'
intents.sample_utterance: My laptop connects to my phone's Wi-Fi hotspot, but says 'Connected, no internet'.

intents.intent_name: Poor Indoor Signal / Dead Zone Troubleshooting
intents.description: User gets outdoor signal but loses all connectivity inside their home or office building
intents.sample_utterance: My signal works fine on the street, but drops to zero bars the moment I walk inside my house.
